    if vert_sep or (ac_max-ac_min >= ar_max-ar_min):
        # horizontal mirror: place adjacent to pattern on arrow's side
        ax = cmax+0.5 if ac_min>cmax else cmin-0.5
        step = 1 if ac_min>cmax else -1
        cols=[]

def f(g):
    H_=W_=len(g); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    P=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(o) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    A=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(o) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    pr0=min(i for i,_ in P); pc0=min(j for _,j in P)
    pr1=max(i for i,_ in P); pc1=max(j for _,j in P)
    for i,j in A: o[i][j]=0
    ar0=min(i for i,_ in A); ac0=min(j for _,j in A)
    # arrow completely right/left of pattern -> horizontal flip; otherwise vertical flip below pattern
    if ac1>=ac0 and not (set(range(ar0,ar1+1)) & set(range(pr0,pr1+1))):
        pass
    # arrow not sharing rows with pattern => horizontal
    shared_rows = bool(set(range(ar0,ar1+1)) & set(range(pr0,pr1+1)))
    if shared_rows:
        for r,c in P:
            cc = 2*(pc1+0.5)-c
            if 0<=cc<W_: o[r][int(cc)]=4
    else:
        for r,c in P:
            rr = 2*(pr1+0.5)-r
            if 0<=rr<H_: o[rr][c]=4
    return o

    H_=W_=len(g); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    P=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(o) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    A=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(o) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]

    pr1=max(i for i,_ in P); pc1=max(j for _,j in P)

    # erase arrows first
    for i,j in A: o[i][j]=0
    for i,j in P: o[i][j]=0  # clear original pattern

        else:
            start=pc0-1
        for r,c in P:
            cc=start+(pc1-c)

    pr0=min(i for i,_ in P); pr1=max(i for i,_ in P)
    pc0=min(j for _,j in P); pc1=max(j for _,j in P)
    ac=sum(i for i,_ in A)/len(A); ajc=sum(j for _,j in A)/len(A)
    best=None
    # all four mirrored placements; keep those that stay in bounds; minimize distance to arrow centroid
    for side,axis in [('b','v'),('t','v'),('r','h'),('l','h')]:
        st = (pr1+1,axis=='v') or None
        if axis=='v':
